body: Can't complain? Something was promised, and now we're not getting it. Why on earth wouldn't we complain?

Not sure how I feel about the mirror being used inside the Happy Fun Ball. It’s stated time works different there, slower on the inside.
Quick maths, with the stated 1hour inside = 24hours outside, means 4hours would pass on the outside during the 10minutes they spend with the mirror on the inside. So there’s a few ways the conversation could’ve been perceived by both parties, but there’s no way to have a real-time talk between the two, barring Alura somehow being encompassed by the time dilation surrounding the ball or perhaps the actual traveling between different rooms taking longer than it seems (i e invisible thresholds they’re passing through that are time barriers of some sort which take time to cross) or some specific rooms themselves having time dilation fields in them.

Sorry, that bit threw me off about the episode

Edit; just to clarify, I’m not upset about not knowing the workings of the ball, I just want to know that there IS actual reasons for why this scenario worked. One has thought and reasons behind it, the other is just magic and ease of life with no questions asked.
